ranked.headline: Statistical models extract structure from spatial and single-cell measurements
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets are increasingly analyzed with explicit statistical models, benchmarks, and denoising methods.

ranked.headline: Auxiliary signals constrain biomedical image representations under domain shift
ranked.summary: Biomedical image models must generalize across sources, cohorts, and modalities, and recent work uses auxiliary signals to constrain them.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of microbial traits from genomic and transcript data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and meta-analyses show computational inference of microbial traits now extends toward community-level interpretation.

ranked.headline: Scalable genome resources and inference across human, avian, viral and ancient DNA
ranked.summary: Petabase-scale search, pedigree-linked imputation and degraded-DNA pipelines now enable inference from public and archival genomic data.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold-guided screening and design of protein and peptide binders
ranked.summary: Structure prediction models now drive virtual screens and iterative design loops for binders, with cell-based and biophysical validation.

ranked.headline: Physics-based free energy methods and learned models predict molecular properties
ranked.summary: Head-to-head benchmarks of binding free energy methods sit alongside physically constrained learning models for enzyme and binding property prediction.

ranked.headline: Graph, tensor, and NMF methods recover spatial organization in omics tissue data
ranked.summary: Spatial proteomics and transcriptomics cohorts now demand scalable methods that preserve tissue context and feature-level variation.

ranked.headline: Fused protein, ligand and graph encoders drive drug-target and drug-disease prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair pretrained language-model and graph encoders across modalities for drug-target and drug-disease prediction.

ranked.headline: Comparative assemblies link repeat expansion and selection to divergent genome structure
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies across Cathaya, Vitaceae, Lupinus and notothenioid fish now allow direct comparison of genome evolution.

ranked.headline: Software converts raw single-cell and spatial measurements into quantified cell-level data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add automated, reference-free frameworks for single-cell proteomics, spatial transcriptomics and immune profiling analysis.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks probe ambiguity and generalization in transcriptomic and multi-omic methods
ranked.summary: Preprints and published benchmarks now test transcriptomic and single-cell methods against controlled ground truths and explicit baselines.

ranked.headline: LLM agents iterate with tools and feedback to design proteins and build biomedical models
ranked.summary: Preprints from April 2026 show LLMs embedded in closed loops for protein sequence design and biomedical ML pipeline construction.

ranked.headline: ML models predict immune recognition of peptides, receptors, and antigen variants
ranked.summary: Preprints extend immune recognition models toward continual learning and structure-aware scoring, with new benchmarks testing generalization to unseen epitopes…

ranked.headline: Integrating rare variants, annotations and omics data to refine genomic prediction
ranked.summary: Polygenic score reproducibility and cross-population transferability are now being tested empirically alongside new prediction frameworks.

ranked.headline: Deep learning integrates spatial, single-cell, and histology data across omics modalities
ranked.summary: Foundation models and uncertainty-aware architectures now link proteomic, spatial, histopathological, and imaging data with molecular profiles.

ranked.headline: Containerized execution and curated model workflows target reproducibility in biology
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs containers, standardized model curation, and integrated workflow execution to target reproducibility.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate multi-step biological workflows, from reproduction to assays
ranked.summary: Agents that execute, check, and orchestrate computational workflows are now being tested on reproduction, drug repurposing, and hard genomics benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Non-missense variant effect scoring spans indels, gene dosage, and protein interfaces
ranked.summary: Recent work calibrates indel predictors to ACMG/AMP evidence levels and quantifies tissue-specific dosage disruption by structural variants.

ranked.headline: Open tools for pangenome graphs, recombination detection, and assembly assessment
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers present pipelines addressing pangenome construction, bacterial recombination, transcriptome assembly quality, and cross-species…

ranked.headline: Generative models steered by latent control to sample protein and RNA structures
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative models with latent control or predictor-based evaluation, extending design beyond sequence toward structural ensembles.

ranked.headline: Modelling non-genetic B cell states and lineage inference in antibody maturation
ranked.summary: Recent models couple non-genetic B cell state dynamics to germinal center evolution and benchmark BCR lineage inference against ground-truth trees.

ranked.headline: Spatial models link cell arrangement and viral spread to immune activation readouts
ranked.summary: Explicit spatial models now link cell arrangement, local and long-range spread, and interferon or T cell activation readouts.

ranked.headline: Pseudotime methods resolve gene dynamics and single-cell chromatin contacts
ranked.summary: Pseudotime frameworks now extend to spatial BCR pairing, reference mapping, transient-event detection, and single-cell Hi-C subtyping.

ranked.headline: Computational models infer gene regulation and interactions from existing omics data
ranked.summary: Dense single-cell, multi-omic, and genetic datasets now support predictive inference of causal, regulatory, and higher-order interaction structure.

ranked.headline: Interface-level scoring and RNA structure modeling methods are advancing
ranked.summary: New tools and diagnostics target nucleic acid interfaces, RNA folding, and CASP16 RNA multimer errors across predicted and experimental structures.

ranked.headline: Representation choice and generalization limits in molecular machine learning
ranked.summary: Recent work ties model performance gaps to embedding geometry and tests whether drug-blind response models generalize beyond shared mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Thermodynamic constraints and latent representations infer metabolic network states
ranked.summary: Recent work treats thermodynamic feasibility and kinetic targets as outputs of constrained or latent representations, not as fixed inputs.

ranked.headline: Protein language models predict enzyme function, RNA binding, and protein expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend protein language model embeddings to enzyme discovery, RNA-protein interaction, and expression prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking automated biological predictors against explicit reference standards
ranked.summary: Recent work evaluates whether automated biological predictions stay reliable under evolving ground truth, held-out splits, and structure-based scores.

ranked.headline: Reproducible workflows and GUI platforms wrap sequencing and genomics analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package established sequencing, GWAS, and cytometry analyses into reproducible, GPU-accelerated or GUI-driven software.

ranked.headline: Path-space quantities as units of inference for stochastic dynamical models
ranked.summary: Trajectory-level data and path-space divergences are being used to infer parameters of stochastic models in single-cell and single-particle settings.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map state-specific conformational landscapes in Rac2, BRAF, and spike
ranked.summary: Dynamics-aware simulations and energetic coupling analyses probe states beyond static structures in GTPase, kinase, and viral protein systems.

ranked.headline: Generalist segmentation models evaluated on live microscopy and spatial-omics data
ranked.summary: Generalist segmentation models are now assessed directly on live microscopy, CODEX, and Xenium spatial-omics data rather than assumed to transfer.

ranked.headline: Proteomics software benchmarks test error control and verifiable FDR reporting
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study benchmark proteomics software and FDR reporting on public and phosphoproteomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Generative and causal models predict single-cell perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Perturbation screens and virtual-cell models now link transcriptomic, imaging, and sequence data to predict gene responses to intervention.

ranked.headline: Perturbation models nominate targets in glioma, metabolism, and drug repurposing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication tie perturbation prediction to cell-state, pharmacodynamic, and clinical readouts during target nomination.

ranked.headline: Explicit force and order models test collective cell behavior against tissue outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a phase-field study quantify specific force terms and order measures against tissue-scale behavior.

ranked.headline: Generative and agentic models annotate metabolites and mine protein-ligand bioactivity
ranked.summary: MetGenX reports 55.9% top-1 accuracy generating structures from MS2 spectra, and MSAgent lifts CASMI retrieval MRR by over 10%.

ranked.headline: Algorithmic correction of calls from low-pass, long-read and single-cell sequencing data
ranked.summary: Deep learning, reinforcement learning and generative augmentation now improve inference from ultra-low-pass, long-read and single-cell cancer sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Genomic context and cell identity shape design and evolution of regulatory DNA
ranked.summary: Regulatory DNA is increasingly modeled through chromosomal position, cell type and evolutionary history rather than as isolated sequence.
